run_robot_interface_example: run the polymetis example that initializes a RobotInterface and moves robot joints to desired positions
create_robot_interface: create a RobotInterface instance connected to localhost for controlling a Franka robot
run_go_home: run the go_home method on a RobotInterface to reset the robot to its home position
run_get_joint_positions: run get_joint_positions on a RobotInterface to read the current joint angles as a tensor
run_move_to_joint_positions: run move_to_joint_positions on a RobotInterface to command the robot to move to a target pose over a specified duration
